bullets: Queried an approximately 79-million-row search-performance warehouse with DuckDB and SQL, aggregating Parquet data for analysis.
Developed Python-based feature-preparation workflows and machine-learning experiments using anonymized search-performance data.
Explored temporal and client-grouped validation approaches to assess model generalization and identify potential data-leakage risks.
Completed a capstone project that was independently reviewed and approved.
Deliver confidential BI engagements, translating business questions into Power BI reports, KPI definitions, semantic models, and DAX measures.
Shape source data with Power Query and SQL, and document metric definitions, transformation logic, and reporting handover.

current_focus: Open to remote Data Analyst and BI Developer roles, with a focus on Power BI reporting, SQL, data modeling, DAX, data validation, and decision-ready reporting.
about_paragraphs: I’m a BI Developer and Data Analyst based in Damietta, Egypt, and open to remote employee roles. My work centers on Power BI reporting, SQL, data modeling, DAX, and clear metric definitions—from source validation through to a report people can explore and explain.

My experience includes freelance BI development and a remote applied machine-learning internship. Alongside that work, I build independent case studies that document data provenance, preparation, modeling decisions, reporting, and limitations.
